reels.script: You can't always answer the phone. You're under a house, up a ladder, hands full. Fine. But here's the move that saves the job. The second you're free, text them back. Sorry I missed you, this is Mike, what's going on? Five minutes. That's the window. Miss it and they've already booked the next guy. A fast text is a booked job. Follow Booked Job.

reels.hook: 20 minutes on Monday buys back real money
reels.script: Twenty minutes every Monday. That's it. Pull up every lead you paid for last week and file a refund on the junk ones. Wrong town, wrong trade, dead phone number, same customer billed twice. That's usually all that qualifies, and there's a clock on it, so waiting till the statement looks weird means it's already gone. Most shops never file a single one. They just complain about the bill. Twenty minutes of paperwork is the difference between a channel that pays and one that quietly doesn't. Follow Booked Job.
reels.description: Do you actually file lead refunds, or just eat them? 20 minutes a week is real money. 👇 #contractor #leads #smallbusiness

reels.script: You can spend a thousand a month on ads, or you can get ten more five-star reviews. Guess which one works while you sleep. Reviews are the only marketing that ranks you higher AND closes the customer before you ever pick up the phone. Ninety percent of homeowners read them before they call. Your reviews are your storefront. Stack them. Follow Booked Job.
reels.description: 10 more reviews will out-earn $1,000 of ads. When's the last time you asked? 👇 #googlereviews #contractor #trades

reels.script: Here's a number that should scare you. Seventy eight percent of homeowners hire whoever gets back to them first. Not the best price. Not the best reviews. First. That means the shop beating you might just be faster than you. And if you're buying shared leads, four other trucks got that same name and number at the same second you did. You're not in a bidding war, you're in a footrace. Answer first, and you win jobs you didn't earn on price. Follow Booked Job.
reels.description: 78% hire whoever responds first. How fast do you actually get back? 👇 #speedtolead #contractor #trades

reels.hook: The shop beating you has 519 reviews
reels.script: You ever wonder why you can't crack the map pack? Here's the bar. The median HVAC shop sitting at the top of local search has around five hundred nineteen Google reviews. Plumbers, about three thirty seven. If you've got twenty two, you're not losing. You're not competing yet. That's not bad news, it's a target. Ten reviews a month, every month, and in two years nobody catches you. Ask every single happy customer, the day you finish. Follow Booked Job.
reels.description: 519 reviews is the median for HVAC shops in the map pack. Where are you at? 👇 #googlereviews #localseo #hvac

reels.script: Here's a brutal number. For every hundred people who land on your website, ninety-eight leave without ever calling. Why? No reviews up top, no click-to-call button, and it takes six seconds to load on a phone. The fix isn't a prettier site. It's a phone number they can tap in one thumb and proof you're not going to rip them off. Make it easy to call you. Follow Booked Job.
reels.description: 98 out of 100 visitors leave your site without calling. Usually it's 3 easy fixes. #website #contractor #leads
78% of homeowners hire whoever responds first — not the cheapest, not the best. If it rings to voicemail, that job's gone. #speedtolead #contractor #trades

reels.hook: Never call your bank over a lead
reels.script: If you buy leads, this one can cost you your whole account. You get charged for a junk lead, you're mad, so you call your bank and dispute it. Here's what happens. The platform puts a hold on your pro account. Sometimes they close it. And every review you spent three years earning goes with it. Fight it their way. File the refund inside the window, keep the screenshots, and if they keep denying you, just turn the budget off. Turning off spend costs you nothing. A chargeback can cost you the account. Follow Booked Job.
reels.description: Ever disputed a lead charge with your bank? Careful — that's how pros lose the account AND the reviews. 👇 #contractor #leads #getpaid

reels.script: Timing is everything on Google reviews. Most guys text a review link three days later, when the customer's already moved on. Here's the fix. The second they say, wow, that looks great, that's your moment. Hand them your phone, right there, review already pulled up. You'll triple your reviews and the reviews rank you higher than any ad. Catch them at wow, not on Wednesday. Follow Booked Job.
reels.description: The best time to ask for a review is the exact second they say 'wow.' When do you ask? 👇 #googlereviews #contractor #trades

reels.hook: Keeping a customer beats finding one
reels.script: It costs about five times more to find a new customer than to keep one you already have. So why do most shops finish a job and vanish? Send a thank-you. Set a reminder to check in before their next service season. A ten-second text six months later turns a one-time job into a customer for life. The work gets you paid once. The relationship gets you paid for years. Follow Booked Job.
reels.description: New customers cost 5x more than keeping old ones. What's your follow-up look like? 👇 #retention #contractor #smallbusiness

reels.hook: Every missed call is a booked job
reels.script: Here's the most expensive sound in your business: your phone ringing while you're under a sink. You don't answer, so they call the next guy. And the next guy books the job. Studies say most homeowners call three shops and hire the first one that picks up. Not the cheapest. The first. If you can't answer, get someone who can. A missed call isn't a missed call. It's a booked job you handed to your competitor. Follow Booked Job.
reels.description: The first shop to pick up usually wins the job — not the cheapest. Who's answering your phone? 👇 #contractor #trades #smallbusiness

reels.hook: The cheapest bid costs the most
reels.script: Ever lose a job to a guy half your price? Let him have it. Here's what happens next. He lowballs the bid to win it, then cuts corners to survive it. The customer pays twice. Once for the cheap job, once for you to fix it. Your price isn't high. It's honest. Don't chase the bottom. Follow Booked Job.
reels.description: Stop apologizing for your price. The lowball always comes back around. #contractor #pricing #trades

reels.script: Three months chasing a customer for a four thousand dollar invoice. Sound familiar? Here's the hard truth. You're not a bank. Every week that invoice sits unpaid, it's a loan you didn't agree to give. Set net terms in writing, take a deposit up front, and don't start the next phase until the last one's paid. The nicest thing you can do for your business is get paid on time. Follow Booked Job.
reels.description: At what point is a $4k unpaid invoice worth the lien? Asking for me. 👇 #getpaid #contractor #smallbusiness

And he admitted he never actually ran a single lead through any of it. That's not a marketing problem, that's a hiding problem. Building the system feels like work. Answering the phone feels like work you already know how to do. Pick up the phone, ask for the review, send the invoice. The boring three beat the whole stack. Follow Booked Job.

reels.script: Real talk about lead sites. The day you stop paying, the phone stops ringing. That's not a pipeline, that's rent. And you're paying it on a lead four other guys bought at the same time. Compare that to your Google profile and your reviews. Nobody can deactivate those, nobody resells them, and they don't send you an invoice at the end of the month. Buy leads if the math works today. Just build the thing they can't take away while you do it. Follow Booked Job.
reels.description: Buying leads is rent. What are you building that they can't shut off? 👇 #contractor #leads #localseo

reels.hook: How you answer a 1-star matters more
reels.script: You got a one-star review. It stings. But here's the thing. Every future customer is going to read your reply, not just the complaint. Answer it calm, professional, and offer to make it right. Do that and the one-star actually builds trust, because it proves you don't run when things go sideways. The review isn't the reputation. Your response is. Follow Booked Job.
reels.description: Future customers read your REPLY to the 1-star, not just the complaint. #reputation #contractor #trades

reels.hook: Your best lead just left your driveway
reels.script: Here's the lead source everybody sleeps on. The customer whose job you just finished. They trust you, they've seen your work, and they know three neighbors with the same problem. But you have to ask. Hey, if you know anyone who needs this done, I'd appreciate the intro. Say it every single time. The cheapest lead you'll ever get is the one you already earned. Follow Booked Job.
reels.description: The customer you just finished is your cheapest lead — if you ask. Do you? 👇 #referrals #contractor #smallbusiness

reels.hook: Your Google profile is a billboard you're ignoring
reels.script: You've got a Google Business Profile you set up once in 2019 and never touched. That's a billboard on the busiest road in town, and you left it blank. Post a job photo every week. Answer every review. Keep your hours right. It's free, it's five minutes, and it's the single biggest thing that decides whether you show up when someone searches your trade near me. Follow Booked Job.
reels.description: Your Google Business Profile is a free billboard. When did you last post on it? 👇 #localSEO #contractor #trades

reels.script: Here's the trap. The phone's ringing now, so you stop marketing. Then January hits and it's dead silent. The work you book in winter was sold in summer. The time to fill the pipe is when you're busy, not when you're broke. Market in your good months. Coast through your slow ones. Follow Booked Job.
reels.description: The busy season is exactly when you should be marketing. Most shops learn this in January. #contractor #smallbusiness

reels.hook: Don't drop the price — add value
reels.script: Customer's on the fence about the price. Do not discount. The second you drop your number, you just told them your first one was made up. Instead, add value. Throw in the extra year of warranty, the follow-up visit, the priority scheduling. Same price, more reasons to say yes. Discounting trains customers to haggle. Adding value trains them to trust you. Follow Booked Job.
reels.description: Discounting says your first price was fake. Add value instead. How do you hold your number? 👇 #pricing #contractor #sales

reels.script: Customer says, since you're already here, can you just waive the service fee? Here's why you don't. That fee isn't for showing up. It's for knowing exactly what's wrong in ten minutes when it'd take them ten hours and a wrecked weekend. The knowledge is the product. You spent years learning to make it look easy. Charge for the easy. Follow Booked Job.
reels.description: The diagnostic fee pays for knowing which part — that's the whole job. Do you hold the line? 👇 #contractor #pricing #trades

reels.script: Customer asks, can you do it cheaper? Here's the answer that stops it cold. Sure. I can use cheaper parts, skip the permit, and rush the job. Or I can do it right, once, and you never think about it again. Which one do you actually want? Cheaper isn't a price. It's a decision about who fixes it next year. Follow Booked Job for more.
reels.description: The one-line answer to 'can you do it cheaper?' What's yours? 👇 #pricing #contractor #trades

reels.hook: The trades don't have a wage problem
reels.script: Everybody says the trades have a labor shortage. That's not it. Posted for a helper this week. Three no-shows and one guy who quit because I asked him to sweep. The trades don't have a wage problem. They have a show-up problem. The guys who actually show up, on time, ready to work? They're worth double and they know it. If that's you, you'll never be out of work. Follow Booked Job.
reels.description: It's not a labor shortage, it's a follow-through shortage. Who's actually reliable and hiring? Drop your city. 👇 #trades #hiring

reels.hook: "I watched a video, it looked easy"
reels.script: Customer tells you, I watched a video, it looked easy. Here's what I've learned to say. It did look easy. That's exactly why I have a job. The video didn't show the corroded fitting behind the wall, the code violation, or the part that's discontinued. You're not paying me to do the easy version. You're paying me so the easy version doesn't turn into a flood at 2 a.m. Follow Booked Job.
reels.description: It looked easy in the video. That's the whole business model. 😅 #plumbing #electrician #contractor #trades

reels.hook: Stop giving free estimates to tire-kickers
reels.script: You drove forty minutes for an estimate and they weren't even home. Sound familiar? Here's the filter. Before you book the estimate, ask two questions. What's the timeline, and is this in the budget you had in mind? The serious customers answer easy. The tire-kickers get weird. That two-minute phone call just saved you a tank of gas and half a Saturday. Qualify before you drive. Follow Booked Job.
reels.description: Qualify on the phone before you drive out. Two questions filter the tire-kickers. #contractor #sales #trades

reels.hook: Offer a payment plan, close more jobs
reels.script: You lose big jobs not because the price is wrong, but because the customer can't write one big check today. Offer financing. A five thousand dollar job becomes a hundred bucks a month, and suddenly it's a yes. The financing company takes a small cut, you get paid in full up front, and the homeowner does the repair they were putting off. It's not about being cheap. It's about being possible. Follow Booked Job.
reels.description: You're losing jobs to the size of the check, not the price. Do you offer financing? 👇 #contractor #sales #trades

reels.script: Learned this one the hard way. Six thousand dollars of custom material sitting in my garage because the customer ghosted after I ordered it. Never again. Now the rule is simple. No deposit, no material order. A serious customer has no problem putting money down. The ones who fight you on a deposit are the ones who'll fight you on the final bill. Protect your cash. Follow Booked Job.
reels.description: What's your deposit rule? The garage full of unpaid material taught me mine. 👇 #getpaid #contractor #smallbusiness

reels.script: Here's three ways your shop bleeds money you never even see. Number one: change orders you never billed for. The job grew, the invoice didn't. Number two: quick favors. There's no such thing as a five minute favor on a paying job. Number three: you're not charging for the drive. Windshield time is still time. Plug those three leaks, and you just gave yourself a raise. Follow Booked Job for more.
reels.description: Three leaks that quietly drain your shop every month. Which one's getting you? 👇 #trades #contractor #smallbusiness

reels.hook: Fast, cheap, or perfect — pick two
reels.script: Customer wants it fast, cheap, and perfect. Here's the line that resets the whole conversation. You can have any two of those. Fast and cheap won't be perfect. Cheap and perfect won't be fast. Fast and perfect won't be cheap. That's not me being difficult. That's just physics. Pick your two and I'll deliver them. Follow Booked Job.
reels.description: Fast, cheap, perfect — pick two. Which two do your customers pick? 👇 #pricing #contractor #trades

reels.hook: Look what the last guy did
reels.script: You ever pull off a panel and just stop? A garden hose where the p-trap should be. Wire nuts buried in a wall. Caulk holding up a roof. The last guy didn't save them money. He sold them a problem with a delay on it. This is why the cheap call is never the cheap call. Follow Booked Job for more from the field.
reels.description: Drop your worst 'the last guy did it' find below. 👇 #plumbing #electrician #hvac #trades

reels.script: While I'm here, can you just take a quick look at this? Eight words that have cost contractors billions. There's no quick look on a paying job. You look, you touch it, you own it. Be helpful, but put it on the invoice. Your time is the product. Follow Booked Job for more.
reels.description: 'While you're here…' — name a more expensive sentence. 👇 #trades #contractor #getpaid

reels.script: Customer wants to do it in cash and skip the paperwork. Sounds like a favor. It's a trap. That paperwork, the contract, the invoice, the permit, that's what protects you when they claim you never did the work, or the inspector comes knocking. No paper means no proof. The five percent you save today is the lawsuit you pay for next year. Always paper the job. Follow Booked Job.
reels.description: 'Cash and skip the paperwork' protects them, not you. How do you say no without losing the job? 👇 #contractor #getpaid #trades

reels.script: Alright, let's start a fight. Milwaukee or DeWalt. Everybody's got a side and nobody's neutral. Red guys swear the torque is unmatched. Yellow guys say theirs never dies. The truth? They're both miles ahead of whatever was in your hand ten years ago. But you already picked a side in your head, didn't you? Tell me which one and why. Follow Booked Job.
reels.description: Milwaukee or DeWalt. Pick a side. The comments are a war zone. 👇 #tools #contractor #trades

reels.hook: "My neighbor's guy does it for half"
reels.script: My neighbor's guy does it for half. Okay. Then call your neighbor's guy. Nine times out of ten they don't, because the half-price guy can't get to it for three weeks, or he already burned that bridge. Your price reflects that you show up, you're licensed, and you'll answer the phone if something goes wrong. Half-price gets you half of all that. Follow Booked Job.
reels.description: 'My neighbor's guy does it for half' — great, go call him. How do you handle it? 👇 #pricing #contractor #trades

reels.script: Let's talk about the greatest mystery in the trades. The 10mm socket. You buy a set, and within a week the 10 is gone. Not the 8, not the 12. Always the 10. It's the most-used size and it vanishes like it's got somewhere to be. I'm convinced there's a landfill somewhere made entirely of 10mm sockets. Where do they go? Tell me your theory. Follow Booked Job.
reels.description: Where do all the 10mm sockets GO? Drop your best theory. 👇 #tools #trades #contractorlife

reels.hook: Set the warranty before there's a problem
reels.script: Biggest fight you'll ever have with a customer is over what's covered, months after the job's done. Kill it before it starts. When you hand over the invoice, walk them through it. Here's what I warranty, here's what I don't, here's how long. Put it in writing. Two minutes at the end of the job saves you a two-hour argument and a bad review later. Clarity up front is free. Follow Booked Job.
reels.description: The warranty fight always happens later. Set expectations in writing at the end of the job. #contractor #trades

reels.script: You're driving an hour each way to a job and only charging for the wrench time. That's two hours a day you're working for free. Fuel, wear on the truck, the time you can't get back. Build a trip charge or a service-area minimum into your pricing. You're not a delivery service. Windshield time is still time, and time is the only thing you actually sell. Follow Booked Job.
reels.description: Driving an hour each way for free? Windshield time is still time. Do you charge for it? 👇 #pricing #contractor #getpaid
